fields.description: Plaza 1 brings apartments and three-level townhouses to Masdar City, Abu Dhabi.

overview: Original mix: 154 studios, 96 one-bedroom apartments, 57 two-bedroom apartments and 41 four-bedroom townhouses; 348 homes altogether.

research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 10/90, with 90% during construction. Projectory instead lists 10/40/50. No original dated calendar was verified.
